title: Marketing Planner
subtitle: Turning a complex planning spreadsheet into a shared operating view for the business.

evidence.statement: ~10–20 minutes of back-and-forth removed from common information requests

quickView.problem: The planning data existed, but the spreadsheet was effectively usable only by teams familiar with it.
quickView.evolution: The existing source of truth remains in place while the experience around it is redesigned.
quickView.product: A shared operating view for planning, comparison, history, and controlled editing.
quickView.impact: Qualitative evidence includes daily merchandising use and company-wide planning visibility.
quickView.learning: Keep the system of record. Redesign how people experience it.
